events.label: birth
events.text: Wilhelm Külz born in Borna near Leipzig.

evidence.quote: Külz was born on 18 February 1875 at Borna near Leipzig

events.text: Married Erna Freymond.

evidence.quote: Külz married Erna Freymond ( 1881–1963 ) in 1901

events.text: Awarded doctorate at the University of Tübingen.

evidence.quote: Also in 1901 , he was awarded a doctorate at the Staatswissenschaftliche Fakultät of the University of Tübingen

events.text: Became mayor of Bückeburg.

evidence.quote: In 1904 , he became mayor of Bückeburg and president of the Landtag of the Principality of Schaumburg-Lippe

events.text: Became president of the Landtag of Schaumburg-Lippe.

evidence.quote: In 1904 , he became mayor of Bückeburg and president of the Landtag of the Principality of Schaumburg-Lippe

events.text: Reichskommissar of German South-West Africa; worked on self-government 1907 to 1908.

evidence.quote: where he worked on establishing self-government in 1907 to 1908

events.text: Reichstag candidate for the National Liberals; not elected.

evidence.quote: Külz was a Reichstag candidate for the National Liberals in 1912

events.text: Elected mayor (Oberbürgermeister) of Zittau.

evidence.quote: The same year , he was elected Oberbürgermeister ( mayor ) of Zittau

events.text: Joined the German Democratic Party (DDP).

evidence.quote: In 1919 , he joined the German Democratic Party ( DDP )

events.text: Began representing the DDP in the Reichstag.

evidence.quote: then from 1922 to 1932 in the Reichstag

events.text: Ended his term as mayor of Zittau (held since 1912).

events.text: Elected 2nd mayor (Bürgermeister) of Dresden.

evidence.quote: In 1923 , he was elected as 2 . Bürgermeister of Dresden

events.text: Became interior minister of Germany in the Luther and Marx cabinets.

evidence.quote: In 1926 , he served as interior minister of Germany
In 1926 to 1927 , Külz served as Reichsminister des Innern

evidence.quote: In 1926 to 1927 , Külz served as Reichsminister des Innern

events.label: private business
events.text: Active as private entrepreneur until 1945; activity ended.

evidence.quote: Until 1945 , he was active as a private entrepreneur

events.label: founding
events.text: Founded the Berlin branch of the LDPD.

evidence.quote: He founded the Berlin branch of the LDPD in the summer of 1945

events.text: Became publisher of the LDPD daily Der Morgen.

evidence.quote: From 1945 on , Külz was the publisher of the LDPD daily Der Morgen

events.text: Acted as LDPD chairman after the first leader was deposed.

evidence.quote: acted as LDPD chairman from November 1945

events.text: Elected co-chairman of the planned DPD with Theodor Heuss.

evidence.quote: On 17 March 1947 , in a conference in Rothenburg ob der Tauber Külz and Theodor Heuss were elected co-chairmen

events.label: congress
events.text: Participated in the SED-dominated German People's Congress.

evidence.quote: that took place on 6 December 1947

events.text: Refused to attend the united DPD leadership session.

evidence.quote: that took place on 18 January 1948 and Külz refused to attend

events.label: congress
events.text: Represented the LDPD at the German People's Congress.

evidence.quote: In March 1948 , Külz once again was the representative of the LDPD at the Deutscher Volkskongress

events.label: death
events.text: Found dead in his Berlin apartment, apparently of a heart attack.

evidence.quote: On the morning of 10 April 1948 , Külz was found by his party deputy
